messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: us-east-1-serving - kv_cache.memory_bytes increased +120% over 3m. continuous_batch.latency_p95 spiked 450ms -> 2100ms. 502/504 error rate +7x. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/s/kv-cache (investigate)
amelia: I'm on call. paging SRE and ML infra. anyone oncall please ack. suspected cause?
zach: ack. looking. Early signs: sudden ballooning of KV entries and batch sizes. Saw continuous_batch.size go from ~1–2 requests per batch to >20 in spikes which then correlate with memory growth.
marta: seeing lots of speculative-prefetch RPCs right before the memory climb. Prefetch appears to create duplicate KV keys for overlapping prefixes when draft/target sync isn't aligned — logs show repeated 'draft_target_sync_mismatch' for same request_id.
ryan: any customer-visible impact yet? are requests timing out or failing with bad output?
customer-ops-simone: A few enterprise tenants reported increased latency and a handful saw 502s during the spike window. Customers: AcmeCorp, Skylab Health, PaperTrail (partial degraded). I've opened notif drafts.
amelia: ok immediate mitigations we can try: 1) disable speculative prefetch (feature flag) 2) reduce continuous batching window and batch_max_tokens to limit mega-batches 3) increase KV eviction aggressiveness temporarily. I'll run 1 and 2 now.
amelia: (running FF toggle)```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_API" -d '{"flag":"speculative_prefetch","value":false}' https://config.redwood.internal/flags
kubectl -n infra patch configmap serving-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"batch_max_tokens":"2000","batch_window_ms":"20"}}'
```
ml-infra-bot: Received flag toggle request. Applying to us-east-1-canary cluster. Will report back.
deploy-bot: Canary job started: rollback speculative-prefetch on canary nodes (us-east-1-serving-canary-3). Logs: apply patch -> success.
zach: after canary flip: memory_gb(us-east-1-serving) trending down 110GB -> 46GB in 12m. continuous_batch.latency_p95 -> 330ms. 502s dropping to baseline. Good sign.
marta: confirming: prefetch RPC rate dropped 98% on canary. However some KV shards still show hot-key churn from earlier duplication; eviction backlog is clearing but slowly. We'll need an eviction throttle bump.
amelia: I've applied transient eviction tweak:```
kubectl -n infra exec -it kv-controller -- curl -XPOST localhost:8080/evict?mode=aggressive
```
amelia: also reverted batch_max_tokens back up to 4000 for non-canary nodes with a safer window while rollout proceeds.
ryan: what about rollout plan? do we push to all nodes or stagger?
deploy-bot: Rolling out to 30% of serving pool now. Healthchecks: pass -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% scheduled. Canary windows 5m between steps. ETA full rollout ~18m.
customer-ops-simone: Sending interim customer message now: "We've identified a perf regression tied to speculative prefetch interacting with our batching layer. We've rolled back the prefetch option and are monitoring. We'll follow up with RCA." :thumbsup:
amelia: good. I'll watch infra metrics for 30m then mark mitigated. marta/ML infra: please open follow-up PRs to dedupe prefetch keys and add a guard against draft/target mismatch creating new KV entries.
marta: filing PRs: 1) prefetch dedupe by prefix hash 2) audit and gate on draft/target sync token. Also adding a telemetry counter for 'prefetch_dedup_skipped'.
ml-infra-bot: Note: we also found a codepath where speculative decode would prefetch targets even when continuous batching combined requests — that duplicated entries across micro-batches. Patch queued: https://git.redwood/ml-infra/pull/2198
zach: metric snapshot post-rollout (12m after start): kv_cache.memory_bytes delta -60GB, continuous_batch.latency_p95 320ms, errors close to baseline. No new 5xx alerts in last 10m.
sre-lead: Great work. Set incident status -> "mitigated". Keep on-call monitoring for 2h. Amelia, please run customer follow-ups and attach postmortem template.
amelia: will do. Handoff to night oncall @julia in 2h. Julia, I'll DM logs and runbook; brief: speculative-prefetch was the proximate trigger interacting with continuous batching to cause KV prefetch duplication and eviction thrash. Root fix work queued with ML infra.
julia: ack. Thanks, I'll take watch at 1946002289. Please tag me on the postmortem when ready.
amelia: Postmortem owners: marta (root cause + fix), zach (SRE mitigation/workflow), simone (customer comms). Timeline and metrics will go into the incident doc. Closing thread for now; monitoring continues. :white_check_mark:
